experiments.name: V2.1 hardened vs V1 champion
experiments.hypothesis: The V2 architecture (opponent-adjusted play-by-play ensemble) predicts margins more accurately than V1 on live 2026 games, as it did on the 2024-25 holdout (-0.28 MAE).
experiments.window: LIVE 2026, promotion evaluation at 150 common official games

experiments.name: V2.1 hardened vs candidate 001
experiments.hypothesis: The pre-registered hardening (two components, equal weights, havoc removed, QB level overlay) costs no accuracy live, as on the holdout (-0.012 MAE).

experiments.name: Prior-by-week fade
experiments.hypothesis: Letting preseason priors fade by week fixes under-use in weeks 0-2 and over-use in weeks 7-10 (development dMAE -0.023).
experiments.window: next offseason release cycle, evaluated on 2027

experiments.name: P4 tier term
experiments.hypothesis: A P4-tier term removes the systematic under-rating of the P4 side in P4-vs-G5 games (development dMAE -0.030).
experiments.window: next offseason release cycle, evaluated on 2027

experiments.name: Loop v2.0.0 vs V1 champion
experiments.hypothesis: The model loop CFB model 2.0.0 (opponent-adjusted EPA unit ratings, a QB carried through transfers, market rating, fitted FCS levels, key-number distribution) predicts margins more accurately than V1 on live 2026 games, as on its 2025 holdout (-0.36 MAE) and its 2026 walk-forward (-0.74 vs V1 as published).
experiments.change: model loop CFB v2 architecture (whole model generation)
experiments.window: LIVE 2026 from 2026-10-21, promotion evaluation at 150 common official games

experiments.name: CLV live tracking: Loop v2.0.0 (W-2) spread vs opener
experiments.challenger: edgedesk_cfb_loop_v2.0.0 CLV rule: |fair margin (ratings+QB through week W-2) - opening spread| >= 3, bet toward the model
experiments.hypothesis: Opening spreads move toward the Loop's W-2 number by the close. Development 2015-19/2021-24: +0.250 pts CLV (3,230 bets); holdout 2025+2026: +0.259 pts, one-sided 99% bound +0.068, permutation p 0.0045 (research/clv_early_week/EXPERIMENTS.md H-4). Expected ROI at the offered price is negative (-3.3%): it beats the close, not the vig.
experiments.change: bet rule on the existing Loop number (no model change)
experiments.window: LIVE 2026 from 2026-10-21, graded by CLV against the close
